title: Marguerite and the Harbor
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Coral Quintana, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
